title: Reflective scenic essay
best_for: one original reflective thesis told over approved real destination footage
minimal narrated TikToks with restrained serif subtitles and no commercial CTA
avoid_when: approved footage cannot support eight meaningful motion intervals
moving burned text, people, faces, logos, or watermarks remain inside a selected interval
the requested story needs facts or locations that the visible footage cannot prove
the brief calls for kinetic typography, a sales offer, or a fast montage
source_contract: Use only owner-approved real motion and record provenance for every source pool
Inspect every selected interval densely; a clean representative frame does not prove that moving burned text or a person stays absent
Remove a contaminated interval rather than covering scenery with a large mask or inherited POC layout
Do not use reference footage, transcript, music, voice identity, branding, or watermark in the derivative
Generated scenery and source claims are excluded from this baseline
creative_contract: Write one original 125-155 word thesis with observation, development, deeper turn, and earned landing line
Map every spoken sentence to a visible supporting scene before narration generation
Use eight-to-twelve source-led motion intervals held mostly three-to-six seconds
Open on useful moving scenery within 0.3 seconds and use simple hard or audio-continuous cuts
Use small centered editorial serif subtitles with four-to-ten words per cue and at most two lines
Normalize subtitle boundaries so simultaneous cues never overlap
Use one warm, intimate narrator and restrained atmospheric music without a commercial CTA
Adapt wording, language, pacing, and source order to the new brief; do not copy the accepted script blindly
qa_contract: Run dense CRV across the complete output and inspect exact interval and subtitle boundaries
Reject any face, person, source heading, source subtitle, inherited overlay, watermark, blank frame, or competing caption system
Verify caption cues contain at most ten words, no overlaps, no black panel, and readable mobile-safe placement
Compare narration against the approved script and confirm every sentence has a supporting visual
Require 1080x1920 H.264 yuv420p at 30 fps with AAC 48 kHz audio and a 45-55 second duration
Target approximately -20 to -16 LUFS integrated loudness and true peak at or below -1.5 dBFS
Require full owner playback before accepting a new voice, story, or source adaptation
hard_rejections: generic slogan chain without one coherent thesis
unsupported location, facility, result, or commercial claim
moving burned source text that appears after a clean opening frame
inherited POC graphics or a second competing caption system
overlapping, oversized, panel-backed, or karaoke subtitles
fewer than eight meaningful motion intervals
technical render promoted without dense visual review and owner playback

canonical_artifacts.role: accepted production blueprint and script example
source-cleanup, Claude-routing, correction, and owner-acceptance audit

notes: Route through truthful-source-recut-v1 plus motivational-narration-v1 and vertical-editorial-v1
Use the tracked blueprint as a decision contract, not an immutable timeline
Create a new dated project and output; never overwrite the accepted proof
Inspect every selected interval densely before composition and again after final encode
Use Claude or another planning worker only inside the bounded contract; OpenMontage remains the composition and QA authority

proof.disposition: Owner said 'not bad very well. lock it' and accepted the corrected scenic essay as a baseline on 2026-07-18
proof.qa: PASS: 50.0 seconds, 1080x1920 H.264 yuv420p at 30 fps, AAC 48 kHz, approximately -18.2 LUFS and -2.1 dBFS true peak; 16 non-overlapping caption cues with at most ten words; no people, source text, inherited overlay, or blank frame in final dense review
